# October 2024 (version 1.95)

Welcome to the October 2024 release of Visual Studio Code.

## Copilot Edits

Copilot Edits lets you start an AI-powered code editing session where you can quickly iterate on code changes.

## Multiple GitHub accounts

It is now possible to be logged in to multiple GitHub accounts in VS Code at the same time.
